meta.title: Koumans par kree enn lien
meta.sub: Konpran kapasite ki deryer konportman-la ek soutien adilt ki rann li posib.

meta.title: Rann lazourne pli fasil pou zere
meta.sub: Anpes sirchaz ki kapav evite atraver bann routinn previzib, enn kominikasion aksesib ek bann adaptasion sansoriel individiel.

meta.title: Reponn avan detres ogmante
meta.sub: Remark bann sign disker ek pratik bann repons kourt ek avek respe ki les lespas pou zanfan-la.

meta.title: Gard tou dimounn an sekirite, apre retrouv lien-la
meta.sub: Konn bann limit sa formasion-la, diminie risk imedia ek soutenir rekiperasion san pinision.

meta.title: Ansegn bann kapasite dan zwe toulezour
meta.sub: Devlop enn ti group kapasite aksesib atraver bann model, repetision ek itilizasion avek soutien.

meta.title: Konstrir plan-la ansam
meta.sub: Travay ansam avek bann fami, met bann tandans itil an ekri ek kone kan bizin plis soutien.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Amira, katran, pe konstrir enn latour. Li tonbe pandan enn lapremidi bien ranpli. Li pous bann blok ater ek dir, “Mo pa kapav!” Yer li ti rekonstrir enn latour parey tousel. Ki repons koumans ko-regilasion dan meyer fason?
o: “To finn fer li yer, alor to kapav fer li aster. Ramas tou avan.”
Apros pre, verifye ki landrwa-la an sekirite ek dir, “Sa finn tonbe. To finn travay dir. Mo kapav ede kan to pare.”
Rekonstrir latour-la net deswit san koz avek li.
practice.why: Sa dekrir levennman-la, rekonet zefor-la ek ofer soutien san exiz enn explikasion ouswa enn performans imedia. Premie travay adilt-la se sekirite ek kree enn lien. Plitar, invit Amira swazir ant rekonstrir, sanz model-la ouswa pran enn poz. Lobzektif-la se partisipasion avek soutien, pa fer zanfan-la paret kalm osi vit ki posib.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Leo, trwa-zan, bous so zorey kan bann sez frot lor planse ek bann zanfan koze pandan tranzision depi zwe pou al ranze. Li rekile ek asiz ater pandan ki bann zanfan rasanble otour bann letazer pou ranze. Li kominike sirtou avek bann zes. Pena okenn diagnostik dan so dosie. Ki premie adaptasion pli itil?
o: Gard li dan group avek tapaz-la ziska li abitie avek son-la.
Dir so fami ki sa konportman-la konfirm enn troub sansoriel.
Diminie tapaz ek foul, ofer enn plas pli trankil anba sirveyans avek enn adilt pre, ek servi enn zes ouswa enn zimaz ki li kone pou montre prosenn letap.
practice.why: Sa diminie bann baryer ki kapav obzerve pandan ki Leo kontign gagn soutien ek enn fason aksesib pou konpran prosenn letap. Apre, koz avek fami-la lor bann sign ek bann preferans itil. Revize si bann pli tipti group, enn reper viziel ki li kone ouswa fer bann group ranze enn apre lot ede. Anrezistr sanzman-la ek so lefe olye met enn letiket lor Leo.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Priya, de-zan, arive ek trouv enn lot adilt pe akey li. Li agrip dimounn ki pe akonpagn li, tourn so figir ek pa dir nanye. Personel trakase ki li pou rat aktivite gramatin-la. Ki repons soutenir tranzision imedia-la?
o: “To enn gran tifi. Dir orevwar ek aret fer tapaz.”
Servi routinn orevwar ki li kone, montre enn aktivite abitie ek ofer soutien enn adilt ki li fer konfians san exiz li koze.
Demann li plizier fwa explik egzakteman kifer li kontrarie.
practice.why: Enn routinn previzib ek enn soutien ki reponn so bann bezwin ed li avek sanzman inatandi-la pandan ki kominikasion Priya respekte. Dakor lor enn plan larive ki posib avek dimounn ki akonpagn zanfan-la ek ekip-la. Pa promet ki enn adilt presi pou touletan disponib. Prepar enn routinn alternativ aksesib pou ki zanfan-la pa depann lor enn garanti inposib.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Ben, sinkan, dan detres apre ki enn zwe fini. Li lev enn sez pandan ki plizier zanfan toupre. Enn lot adilt disponib. Sa enn inkietid imedia pou sekirite, pa enn zwe rol pou esey avek bann zanfan. Ki bizin gid premie repons-la?
o: Insiste ki li explik so bann santiman avan personn bouze.
Esey enn teknik pou tini enn zanfan ki ou rapel depi enn ti video an-lign.
Apel soutien forme ki finn dakor ek ed kree enn lespas an sekirite pou bann lezot dimounn, an swiv plan dirzans lokal.
practice.why: Protez bann dimounn, gard sirveyans ek demann led apropriye pas avan lansegnman ouswa diskision. Aksion ki an sekirite depann lor vre lanvironnman ek bann prosedir lokal. Pratik kominikasion ant personel atraver diskision, zame par fer bann zanfan met enn konportman danzere an senn. Insidan-la bizin amenn enn revizion planifikasion soutien ek sekirite.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Sofia, katran, pratik servi enn kart led pandan enn leson an ti group. Pandan goute, so bwat pa pe ouver. Li plore ek pous li lwen. Kart-la ankor dan enn tirwar klas. Ki adilt-la bizin sanze?
o: Met soutien kominikasion kot zanfan-la kapav ariv ek pratik servi li dan bann vre routinn ki li kapav zere.
Pa donn li led ziska li montre kart-la korekteman.
Konklir ki Sofia finn bliye leson-la ek repet li pli for.
practice.why: Enn kapasite ki finn ansegne bizin enn loportinite aksesib pou vinn itil. Reponn demann led aktiel Sofia ek amelyor akse pou lavenir osi. Ekip-la verifye kot bann sinbol ouswa laparey neseser, demann ekip kominikasion zanfan-la lor bann soutien ki deza etabli ek pratik dan bann routinn abitie. Enn leson reisi pa garanti ki zanfan-la pou servi kapasite-la tousel anba stres.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Personel remarke ki Noah, sinkan, regilierman retir limem pandan sante an gran group ek parfwa rat aktivite-la. Dimounn ki okip li dir, “Li sante touletan lakaz.” Toulede temwaniaz kapav vre. Ki fason koumans konversasion-la konstrir pli bien enn plan itil?
o: “Li bizin pe swazir konport li dan enn lot fason isi.”
“Li kontan bann sante ki li swazir dan bann ti group. Dan gran group-la li elwagne. Kouma sante pase lakaz, ek ki ed li santi li alez?”
“Nou bizin enn diagnostik avan nou kapav sanz aktivite-la.”
practice.why: Sa partaz enn pwin for, dekrir konteks-la ek invit konesans fami-la avan swazir enn adaptasion. Dat revizion-la se enn lexanp, pa enn interval klinik obligatwar. Dakor lor enn moman apropriye ek demann led pli boner si risk ouswa inkietid ogmante. Gete si swazir enn sante, obzerv avan ouswa partisipe depi enn plas pli trankil amelyor akse.

declarations: Mo pou reponn detres avek dignite, enn kominikasion aksesib ek ko-regilasion par enn adilt, pandan ki mo gard tou dimounn an sekirite.
Mo pou adapt bann routinn ek bann atant selon devlopman zanfan-la, so bann bezwin kominikasion ek sansoriel, ek mo pou ansegn bann kapasite kan zanfan-la pare.
Mo pa pou servi imiliasion, menas, izolman, fors enn zanfan get mwa dan lizie, fors lafeksion ouswa priv li bann swin neseser pou fer li obeir.

Mo pou swiv bann prosedir aktiel lekol pou proteksion zanfan, sirveyans ek bann ka irzan, rod led bann dimounn forme ek res dan limit mo rol. Sa formasion-la pa ansegne ni otoriz imobiliz enn zanfan par lafors.
Mo konpran ki sa sertifika-la konsern zis laprantisaz an-lign. Mo pou servi bann sistem lekol aprouve pou bann vre inkietid, bann plan soutien ek kominikasion avek bann fami, zame sa formasion-la.

localReadiness.title: Konn zanfan-la ek routinn-la
localReadiness.text: Aprann kouma sak zanfan kominike, so bann lintere, so bann preferans sansoriel ek bann soutien aktiel ki finn dakor. Demann bann fami ki ede, san sipoze ki mem stratezi marse partou.

localReadiness.title: Konn ou prop soutien
localReadiness.text: Dakor lor enn ti signal pou demann led avek bann koleg, kisannla res avek zanfan-la ek kisannla sirvey group-la. Si ou santi ou depase, organiz enn rele an sekirite; zame zis ale kit ou plas.

localReadiness.title: Fer lanvironnman-la aksesib
localReadiness.text: Verifye bann tranzision, letan atann, tapaz, tro boukou dimounn ansam ek posibilite pou bouze, servi bann led kominikasion ek al dan enn lespas pli trankil anba sirveyans. Enn lespas trankil se enn soutien opsionel, zame enn pinision ouswa enn lasam ferme a kle.

localReadiness.title: Dakor lor bann repons koeran ek fleksib
localReadiness.text: Servi bann ti fraz ki zanfan-la kone ek bann vre swa. Les li letan pou konpran ek respekte so kominikasion, inklir bann zes ouswa kominikasion alternativ ek amelyore (AAC). Paret kalm, res imobil ek get dan lizie pa prev ki zanfan-la finn regil so lemosion.

localReadiness.title: Konn bann prosedir led ek signalman
localReadiness.text: Konfirm kisannla ou responsab ELS/inklizion, responsab proteksion zanfan, lot prosedir indepandan, soutien premie sekour ek prosedir pou ka irzan. Enn risk irzan bizin led vit, pa enn lot stratezi pou konportman.

localReadiness.title: Reviz avek bann fe ek bann fami
localReadiness.text: Dekrir seki finn pase avan, seki zanfan-la finn fer, seki bann adilt finn sanze ek seki finn ede. Gard bann not baze lor bann fe, kourt ek an sekirite. Demann konsey bann spesialis atraver prosedir ki finn dakor kan bann bezwin persiste, vinn pli for ouswa afekte partisipasion.

practical.title: Gid pratik ko-regilasion an ekip
practical.intro: Pou enn repetision ant bann adilt ouswa enn diskision an ekip avek enn sitiasion imaziner. Swazir enn routinn dan formasion-la ek pratik enn repons kalm ek koeran. Lobzektif-la se enn travay an ekip ki donn soutien, pa enn performans anba presion.
instructions: Swazir enn sitiasion imaziner arive, tranzision, enn lasam avek tapaz ouswa enn konfli ant zanfan. Dakor lor bann bezwin devlopman, kominikasion ek sansoriel zanfan-la avan ou koumanse.
Deside kisannla pou koze, kisannla pou sirvey bann lezot zanfan ek kouma pou demann led. Pratik zis bann parol, bann swa ek bann sanzman dan lanvironnman; pa pratik enn intervansion fizik.
Pran sakenn zot tour kouma adilt ki donn soutien ek kouma obzervater. Personn pa bizin imit detres enn vre zanfan. Met an poz kan enn partisipan anvi.
Diskit seki finn prezerv dignite ek akse, seki kapav azout presion ek seki zot ti pou fer si sekirite sanze. Servi bann prosedir aktiel lekol.
Swazir enn ti sanzman pou esey dan pratik toulezour ek enn dat pou reviz li. Gard bann dosie lor bann vre zanfan dan sistem sekirize ki lekol finn aprouve.

items: Obzerv so prop ritm, so lavwa ek so tansyon ek idantifie enn fason pas rele an sekirite.
Planifie sirveyans group-la, led ek enn opsion pli trankil ek aksesib san izolman.
Antisip bann bezwin kominikasion, sansoriel ek devlopman zanfan-la.
Dekrir sign ki kapav obzerve san dir ki zanfan-la move ouswa manipilater.
Servi enn ti fraz ranpli avek bienveyans, enn distans konfortab ek letan pou konpran.
Ofer bann vre swa aksesib, san exiz ki zanfan-la koze, get dan lizie, aksepte tous ouswa fer bann lexersis respirasion.

criteria.area: 3. Met sekirite an premie kan detres ogmante
items: Diminie bann demann ek bann dimounn ki pe gete, protez bann lezot zanfan ek demann led bann dimounn forme kan neseser.
Explik bann prosedir pou ka irzan ek proteksion zanfan ek bann limit sa formasion-la; okenn teknik ki restrenn enn zanfan pa pratike.
Gard enn sirveyans ki donn soutien ek bann swin neseser; pa servi izolman forse, menas ouswa imiliasion.
Les letan pou zanfan-la rekipere avan enn diskision, bann exkiz ouswa rod bann solision.
Ofer enn fason repar seki finn pase ki zanfan-la kapav fer, ek pratik enn kapasite itil pou kominike ouswa fer fas kan zanfan-la pare.
Idantifie enn sanzman kot adilt-la ouswa dan lanvironnman, enn letap pou travay ansam avek fami-la ek kan pou demann plis soutien.

decisionOptions: Dakor lor enn ti sanzman ek enn dat swivi
Demann konsey responsab lekol konserne avan sanz plan zanfan-la
practical.footer: Servi sa kouma enn fason koumans enn diskision anplis lakey ek gidans personel dan lekol. Zis lekol kapav fixe bann lotorizasion selon bann rol ouswa aprouv bann plan individiel. Enn fis pratik ranpli pa etabli konpetans klinik ni lotorizasion pou enn intervansion ki restrenn enn zanfan.

visualGuides.title: Enn adilt stab
visualGuides.intro: Enn ti repetision pou ou prop premie repons. Bann bezwin ek fason bann zanfan rekipere diferan; sa pa enn seri letap fixe ki zot oblize swiv.

steps.title: Obzerv oumem
steps.text: Obzerv ou lavwa, ou ritm ek ou tansyon. Pran enn ti poz konfortab si ou kapav fer li an sekirite.

steps.title: Stabiliz ou repons
steps.text: Bese ou lavwa, relaks ou pozision lekor ek swazir mwins mo. Enn prezans kalm demann pratik.

steps.title: Kree enn lien san presion
steps.text: Res disponib dan enn distans ki zanfan-la kapav tolere. Montre bienveyans san insiste lor tous ouswa get dan lizie.

steps.title: Fer enn sanzman itil
steps.text: Diminie enn demann ouswa enn sours sirchaz. Ofer enn swa aksesib ki ou kapav respekte.

steps.title: Fer apel a soutien
steps.text: Demann enn koleg enn rele an sekirite kan neseser, avek enn sirveyans bien kler pou zanfan-la ek group-la.

visualGuides.title: Mwins presion, plis soutien
visualGuides.intro: Imazinn enn zanfan ki bous so zorey ek ki elwagne pandan ki klas-la pe met an ran. Pratik enn repons avan so detres ogmante.

steps.title: Obzerv sign-la
steps.text: Dekrir seki ou trouve: lame lor zorey, pe rekile, mwins parol. Pa devinn enn lintansion.

steps.title: Sanz bann kondision
steps.text: Diminie tapaz ek kantite dimounn ansam. Ofer enn plas pli trankil anba sirveyans ouswa enn tranzision dan enn lot moman.

steps.title: Servi enn ti fraz
steps.text: “Ena tapaz. Mo la. Nou kapav atann isi ansam.” Les zanfan-la letan pou konpran.

steps.title: Ofer enn vre swa
steps.text: “Mars akote mwa ouswa deryer?” Servi enn zes, enn zimaz ouswa enn sistem kominikasion ki li kone si sa ede.

steps.title: Obzerv repons-la
steps.text: Res fleksib. Si detres ouswa risk ogmante, aret azout bann demann ek swiv plan soutien ek sekirite lekol.

visualGuides.title: Rekipere form parti soutien-la
visualGuides.intro: Moman difisil-la kapav finn pase, me kapasite pou koze ouswa aprann kapav pran letan pou revini. Pa prese pou koriz.

steps.title: Gard soutien disponib
steps.text: Gard sirveyans, enn lanvironnman kalm ek bann swin neseser. Pa retir rekonfor kouma enn konsekans.

steps.title: Ofer, pa insiste
steps.text: Ofer bann soutien ki zanfan-la kone pou kalme li. Respirasion, tous ouswa koze kapav pa ed tou zanfan.

steps.title: Atann ki zanfan-la pare
steps.text: Obzerv so bann sign abitie konfor ek partisipasion. Pa exiz enn explikasion ouswa bann exkiz deswit.

steps.title: Retrouv lien-la ek repare
steps.text: Kan zanfan-la pare, ed li repar seki finn pase dan enn fason li kapav fer: get si enn kamarad bien, rekonstrir ansam ouswa swazir enn lot fason demann.

steps.title: Reviz plan bann adilt
steps.text: Ki finn pase avan? Ki nou finn sanze? Ki finn ede? Partaz bann fe an sekirite ek adapt plan-la avek ekip-la ek fami-la.
